# GoldenCrate - Farm Logistics UI Analysis

## 1. Color Palette
- **Primary Blue**: #2D5A87 (header background, button accents)
- **Dark Navy**: #1A2332 (navigation button, CTA buttons)
- **Light Gray**: #F5F7FA (section backgrounds, card backgrounds)
- **Medium Gray**: #E0E5EB (dividers, subtle borders)
- **Text Black**: #1A1A1A (primary text)
- **Text Gray**: #6B7280 (secondary text, descriptions)
- **White**: #FFFFFF (text, backgrounds)
- **Accent Green**: #4CAF50 (hero background gradient, natural elements)
- **Accent Yellow**: #FFC107 (subtle highlights, badges)

## 2. Typography
- **Headings**: Montserrat Bold, 36px-48px, letter-spacing: -0.02em
- **Subheadings**: Montserrat SemiBold, 24px-28px, letter-spacing: -0.01em
- **Body Text**: Inter Regular, 16px, line-height: 1.6
- **Small Text**: Inter Regular, 14px, line-height: 1.5
- **CTA Text**: Montserrat Bold, 16px, letter-spacing: 0.5px

## 3. Layout Structure
- **Header**: Fixed top navigation with logo and contact button
- **Hero Section**: Full-width background image with overlay text and CTA
- **Why Choose Us**: Three-column feature grid with numbered badges
- **What Sets Us Apart**: Icon-list section with circular icons
- **Trusted by Industry Leaders**: Three-column testimonial cards with carousel navigation
- **Delivery Request**: Full-width form section with background image

## 4. Spacing and Component Styling
- **Card Padding**: 32px (vertical) × 24px (horizontal)
- **Section Margins**: 80px (vertical) between sections
- **Button Padding**: 12px 24px (small), 16px 32px (large)
- **Border Radius**: 8px (cards, buttons, inputs)
- **Shadow**: Subtle 0 4px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.1) on cards
- **Input Fields**: 16px padding, 1px solid #E0E5EB border

## 5. Unique Design Elements
- **Numbered Badges**: Dark circular badges with white text (01, 02, 03)
- **Line Icons**: Minimalist stroke icons for features
- **Carousel Arrows**: Rounded navigation buttons with hover states
- **Gradient Overlays**: Subtle blue-to-transparent gradients on hero images
- **Feature Icons**: Circular icons with thin borders and centered icons
- **Form Sections**: Semi-transparent white background with rounded corners

## 6. Overall Aesthetic
Modern, clean, and professional with a focus on trust and reliability. The design uses natural imagery and earthy tones balanced with professional blue accents. The layout is structured and hierarchical, emphasizing clarity and ease of navigation.

## 7. Navigation Styling
- **Logo**: "GoldenCrate" in white, Montserrat Bold, 18px
- **Contact Button**: Dark navy background, white text, rounded corners, hover state with slight opacity change
- **Mobile Menu**: Hidden in desktop view, likely hamburger menu in mobile

## 8. Hero Section Composition
- **Background**: Full-width image of a cow against blue sky with clouds
- **Overlay**: Semi-transparent blue gradient (top to bottom)
- **Headline**: "Fresh farm products – delivered on time, under full temperature control" in white, 36px Montserrat Bold
- **Subheadline**: "We deliver meat, dairy, greens, and ready-to-cook goods across Europe" in white, 18px Inter Regular
- **CTA Button**: "Book Delivery" with arrow icon, white background, dark navy text, rounded corners
- **Central Image**: Cow positioned in the middle-right of the section

## Additional Details
- **Why Choose Us Cards**: Each card has a light gray background, line icon, numbered badge, and descriptive text
- **What Sets Us Apart**: Five features with circular icons (clock, temperature, document, farm, GPS) and descriptive text
- **Trusted by Cards**: Three cards with background images, category labels, and descriptive text
- **Delivery Request Form**: Three input fields with placeholder text and a submit button with arrow icon
- **Consistent Spacing**: 24px gaps between elements, 32px padding within containers
